##### Project general facts

Aria Heights is a contemporary 16-floor residential tower developed by SRG, featuring a collection of beautifully designed residences ranging from cozy studios to spacious three-bedroom apartments. Each home is thoughtfully crafted with open layouts, high ceilings, and expansive windows, creating bright and airy living spaces that reflect SRG's dedication to excellence. With panoramic views from spacious balconies and expansive terraces in garden apartments, Aria Heights offers a perfect balance of indoor and outdoor living.

Aria Heights is designed to offer residents a full range of luxury amenities that make life convenient and enjoyable. An expansive swimming pool and a dedicated kids' pool provide refreshing escapes, while a fully equipped gym caters to fitness enthusiasts. Outdoor lounging spaces offer the perfect setting for relaxation and socializing, with thoughtfully designed spaces that inspire a focus on well-being. Every element is crafted to create the perfect balance of relaxation and activity.

Every residence at Aria Heights features high-quality finishes for doors, wardrobes, kitchen cabinets, and vanity cabinets, crafted to perfection. Sophisticated Italian vitrified tiles deliver timeless elegance and durability, while a high-performance Low-E facade system with expansive floor-to-ceiling windows ensures abundant natural light. Kitchens are fully fitted with state-of-the-art built-in appliances from prestigious European brands including Siemens and Smeg, and bathrooms feature premium sanitary fittings and accessories from renowned brands such as Gessi, Geberit, and Flaminia.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, a vibrant and rapidly growing community that captivates residents and visitors alike, this exceptional location offers a harmonious blend of modern living and natural beauty. The idyllic circular-shaped neighborhood features tree-lined streets, tranquil parks, and spacious villas and apartments, creating a truly unique and welcoming place to call home.

The location is distinguished by its sense of peace and balance, providing a welcome escape from the hustle and bustle of city life while still being conveniently located within Dubai. Residents enjoy a host of amenities, including schools, shopping centers, parks, and recreational facilities, all thoughtfully integrated into the community's design. It is a place where families thrive, professionals find a convenient home, and nature lovers revel in the serene surroundings.

For those seeking a residence that embodies modern elegance, community connection, and a prime Dubai address, Jumeirah Village Circle delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of tree-lined streets, tranquil parks, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living.
